documents.text: Employees receive 12 casual leave days every calendar year. Unused casual leave does not carry forward to the next year.
Employees can take up to 5 days of emergency leave for urgent personal or family situations, such as a medical emergency or a death in the family.
Sick leave longer than two consecutive working days requires a medical certificate from a registered doctor.
Staff may work from home up to two days per week with prior approval from their reporting manager.
Virtual threads, final since Java 21, are lightweight threads scheduled by the JVM. They make it practical to run thousands of concurrent blocking tasks.
A Java record is a concise class for immutable data. The compiler generates the constructor, accessor methods, equals, hashCode and toString.
A Java interface declares methods that implementing classes must provide. Since Java 8 an interface can also contain default methods with a body.
The JVM garbage collector automatically reclaims memory used by objects that are no longer reachable, so developers never free memory manually.
A Java method declared with the void return type does not return a value to its caller.
Spring Boot provides dependency injection: the container creates objects and passes their dependencies through constructors instead of the objects creating them.
A Spring bean is an object whose lifecycle is managed by the Spring IoC container, from instantiation and wiring to destruction.
A Spring Boot web application listens on port 8080 unless a different value is set with the server.port property.
Spring Boot Actuator exposes operational endpoints such as /actuator/health and /actuator/metrics to monitor a running application.
To reset your password, click 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page and follow the link we email you. The link expires after 30 minutes.
Unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method.
Customers can leave a product review from the Orders page once the item has been delivered.
Track your order with the tracking number included in the shipping confirmation email.
Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days; express shipping arrives within 1 to 2 business days.
Our single-origin Arabica coffee beans are roasted in small batches and packed in resealable 500 g bags.
Premium cotton bed sheets with a 400 thread count, available in queen and king sizes.
Wireless over-ear headphones with active noise cancellation and up to 30 hours of battery life.
Electric standing desk with height adjustable from 70 to 120 cm and a keypad that remembers four positions.
Applicants for a personal loan must be at least 21 years old and earn a minimum monthly income of 25,000 INR.
Borrowers may repay a personal loan before the end of its term. No prepayment penalty applies after the first 12 EMIs have been paid.
If a borrower misses three consecutive EMI payments, the loan is classified as in default and reported to credit bureaus.
Personal loan interest rates range from 10.5% to 16% per year depending on the applicant's credit score.
A Docker Compose health check runs a command inside the container at an interval; dependent services can wait until the container reports healthy.
A B-tree index in PostgreSQL speeds up equality and range queries on a column but adds overhead to every insert and update.
HTTP status 429 Too Many Requests means the client exceeded the rate limit and should retry after the delay given in the Retry-After header.
An idempotent REST operation has the same effect whether it is called once or many times, which makes automatic retries safe.
